what: Public Suffix List, archived so the ICANN-vs-private-section distinction behind the Rule 1 correction (PR #2979) is reproducible against a fixed list.
why: Rule 1 as proposed says 'eTLD+1 via the PSL'. Against the full list the 32 changes collapse to 29 units (9%); against the ICANN section only, 23 (28%). Platform suffixes (up.railway.app, workers.dev, vercel.app) are private-section entries.
